warnings.title: Minor Flood Warning for the Upper Condamine River
areas: Condamine River downstream of Warwick to Oakey Creek
warnings.situation:
MINOR FLOODING OCCURRING AT TUMMAVILLE 
Thunderstorms have produced heavy rainfall since Friday afternoon in parts of the Upper Condamine River catchment. River and creek levels are rising and isolated flooding is occurring. Minor flooding is occurring at Tummaville.
Further rainfall is forecast over the Upper Condamine catchment in the next few days.
warnings.nextIssue: The next warning will be issued by 03:00 PM AEST on Sunday 15 November 2026.

warnings.title: Minor Flood Warning for the Lower Barcoo River and Cooper Creek and Flood Warning for the Thomson River
areas: Thomson and Barcoo Rivers and Cooper Creek
warnings.situation:
MINOR FLOODING OCCURRING AT RETREAT AND WINDORAH
Along the upper Thomson River, minor flooding has eased at Camoola Park. The peak is now approaching Bogewong where minor flooding is occurring.
Along the lower Barcoo River minor flooding is easing at Retreat. The peak from the Barcoo River has just passed Windorah, where minor flooding is slowly easing.
warnings.nextIssue: The next warning will be issued by 02:00 PM AEST on Monday 16 November 2026.

warnings.title: Minor Flood Warning for the Warrego River (NSW)
warnings.situation:
MINOR FLOODING OCCURRING AT BARRINGUN AND ENNGONIA
A minor flood peak along Warrego River is approaching Enngonia, where river levels are likely to remain above the minor flood level during the weekend. Further downstream, river levels are rising at Fords Bridge. Predictions for Fords Bridge will be provided once the flood peak is observed at Enngonia.
warnings.nextIssue: The next warning will be issued by 01:00 PM AEDT on Monday 16 November 2026.

warnings.title: Final Flood Warning for the Warrego River (QLD)
warnings.situation:
MINOR FLOODING NO LONGER OCCURRING AT ROCKY
The river level along the lower Warrego River at Rocky is estimated to have fallen below the minor flood level and is expected to remain below the minor flood level. 
A minor flood warning is current for the Warrego River (NSW).
warnings.nextIssue: This is a final warning. No further warnings will be issued for this event.
